高考英语3500词 · 12英文原文

Balanced Diet

均衡饮食 · 181 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Wang Peng earned his living by running a barbecue restaurant, which served delicious bacon, fried chicken breast and mutton roasted with pepper and garlic. But his food and discounts attracted fewer and fewer customers. Eventually, he fell into debt. Yong Hui’s slimming restaurant served fresh peas, carrots, eggplants, and raw cucumbers with vinegar. As the hostess, she said dietary fibre was especially good for her customers’ digestion. Wang Peng did not want Yong Hui to get away with lying, so he spied on her despite her angry glare. But he was surprised that she was losing her customers, too.

2Curiosity drove Wang Peng to consult an expert. The expert sighed and said, “Both menus have weaknesses and only limited benefits. Your customers put on weight too easily, while Yong Hui’s lose weight too quickly. So, Wang Peng, cut down on the fat in your dishes and add more fruit, vegetables and other foods, such as nuts, beans, mushrooms, peaches and lemons. You ought to combine the two menus and provide a balanced diet.”

3Before long, Wang Peng won his customers back.

高考英语3500词 · 12中文译文

均衡饮食

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1王鹏靠开烧烤店谋生，店里有美味的培根、炸鸡胸，还有用胡椒和蒜烤的羊肉。可是，饭菜和折扣吸引来的客人越来越少，最后他欠下了债。雍慧开的是一家减肥餐厅，供应新鲜的豌豆、胡萝卜和茄子，还有拌醋的生黄瓜。身为老板娘，她说膳食纤维最有助于顾客消化。王鹏不想让雍慧说了假话还蒙混过去，便不顾她的怒视，暗中打探。没想到，雍慧的客人也在流失。

2王鹏实在好奇，就去请教一位专家。专家叹了口气，说：“你们两家的菜单各有弱点，长处也有限。你的顾客太容易发胖，雍慧的顾客又瘦得太快。王鹏，你得少放些油脂，多加些蔬果等食材，比如坚果、豆类、蘑菇、桃子和柠檬。把两家的菜单结合起来，才好给顾客提供均衡的饮食。”

3没多久，王鹏就把顾客重新赢了回来。
